title: Louis Lefebvre
why_it_fits: Pioneer of avian cognitive-innovation research ('How do big brains evolve?') — squarely on the bird/comparative-cognition profile; CREAF/UAB tie makes it a genuinely local door if he is on campus.
eligibility_notes: Fit caveat: primary affiliation is McGill (Montreal); CREAF/UAB is a secondary Barcelona affiliation — confirm he is locally based before assuming in-person reach.
institution: CREAF, Autonomous University of Barcelona (primary: McGill University, Montreal)

title: Comparative Cognition Society (CO3)
why_it_fits: THE defining society for this profile. Student awards (publication, best talk/poster, travel) plus the Stan Kuczaj Memorial Travel Grant; a separate Early Career Award exists for later (first 5 yrs post-PhD, $1000).
eligibility_notes: Must be a current CCS member to apply for any of the awards.
deadline: student-award deadlines ~Dec; Stan Kuczaj travel grant ~28 Feb

title: European Society for Evolutionary Biology (ESEB)
why_it_fits: Research-exchange and outreach funding; relevant on the evolution/culture angle of the profile.
eligibility_notes: No specific open call surfaced this run — check current schemes on-site.

title: International Society for Behavioral Ecology (ISBE)
why_it_fits: Congress travel awards + occasional grants, directly on-profile for behavioural ecology.
eligibility_notes: Confirm current schemes on-site — no specific deadline parsed this run.

id: source::Company of Biologists — DMM/JEB conference & partnership travel grants
title: Company of Biologists — DMM/JEB conference & partnership travel grants
why_it_fits: Distinct from the flagship Travelling Fellowships — a smaller, complementary line for cheap conference attendance (JEB is a strong-fit journal for the behaviour/physiology angle).
eligibility_notes: Some conference-attendance travel grants require SEB membership — check per-scheme.
deadline: quarterly (SEB-linked travel grant: 31 Mar / 30 Jun / 30 Sep / 31 Dec)

id: source::SEEEE — Sociedad Española de Etología y Ecología Evolutiva
title: SEEEE — Sociedad Española de Etología y Ecología Evolutiva
why_it_fits: The Spanish ethology/evolutionary-ecology society — directly on-profile and Spain-based; runs young-researcher / best-thesis awards plus congress travel support.
eligibility_notes: No specific deadline parsed this run — check the current cycle on-site.

id: source::AEI — Agencia Estatal de Investigación (all calls)
title: AEI — Agencia Estatal de Investigación (all calls)
why_it_fits: Master index of all Spanish state research funding (predoc/postdoc); the place to check for FPI-adjacent and other rolling national calls.
eligibility_notes: Broad portal — no specific open call surfaced this run; needs manual browsing/filtering by tag.

title: Company of Biologists — Travelling Fellowships
why_it_fits: Up to £3k for ECRs to undertake a collaborative lab visit — no nationality restriction, JEB is the best-fit journal. Concrete and immediately actionable.

title: ASAB Research Grants
why_it_fits: Up to £10k (£15k with justification), explicitly to fund travel to conduct collaborative research or bring a collaborator to you — strong match for a methods exchange (e.g. GLM-HMM/behavioural-modelling).
eligibility_notes: Does not usually accept applicants based in the Americas — no issue, Spain-based.

title: Per Jensen
why_it_fits: PI, AVIAN Behavioural Genomics and Physiology group, Linkoping University. Review 'Are domesticated animals dumber than their wild relatives?' sits in comparative-cognition territory. Co-author Vitor Hugo Bessa Ferreira (INRAE/Tours) a possible second contact.
eligibility_notes: Cold lead, no warm tie. Confirm what career stage the lab is recruiting/hosting for before reaching out.

title: Animal Behavior Society — Grants & Awards
why_it_fits: Early Career Research Grants, Student Research Grants, Travel Awards, plus named awards — broad, on-profile funding menu for animal-behaviour ECRs.
eligibility_notes: Many of these awards require ABS (or ASAB) membership in good standing — join before applying.

title: ASAB Scholarships & smaller grants
why_it_fits: Conference support, education grants, and caregiver grants alongside the main ASAB Research Grants line — worth skimming for anything ECR-eligible.
